desc:
🕺 Trendy Features 100+ dances inspired by trending moves!
✨ The Primary Activity is Simulation, Dance to earn XP Levels!
🔥 Level UP to earn XP Levels faster!

🎶 20+ NEW DANCES FEATURING "I GOT THAT FEELING" & "PAPARAZZI"
👗 Dress up with various morphs.

💭 Free Commands:
/Korblox /Headless

👍 LIKE and ⭐ Favorite the game for more UPDATES!

The primary activity in this Experience is Simulation. Players control their character by clicking buttons to perform dance moves and earn XP every 30 seconds. As players level up, the XP gain rate automatically increases, allowing them to progress faster through the levels.

All in-game music is sourced from the official Roblox music catalog; we have no control over this.
